root_cause: The initial sidepanel graph included @cartesia/cartesia-js through useCartesiaSpeaker's static import. Cartesia's qs dependency loads side-channel and object-inspect. object-inspect/index.js reads require('./util.inspect').custom at module initialization, although its package declares ./util.inspect.js false for browsers. Vite represents that false browser mapping with a throwing browser-external proxy, so the optional property read crashes the whole panel before Settings or Scrape render.
evidence: docs/stabilization/runs/guest-local-001.json captured the exact browser-externalized .custom error on two sidepanel opens from source f70ecd47.
The baseline bundle's use-agent-execution chunk imports __vite-browser-external and contains object-inspect's F=f(),I=F.custom at byte 305409.
node_modules/.pnpm/object-inspect@1.13.4/node_modules/object-inspect/util.inspect.js requires Node util.inspect; its package.json browser field maps ./util.inspect.js to false.
sibling_census: The only direct Cartesia SDK import in extension source is src/lib/tts/useCartesiaSpeaker.ts. Other built browser externals remain to be assessed by the fresh-bundle and UI check; this report closes only the confirmed .custom crash.
change: Load Cartesia on speech connection instead of panel module evaluation.

Map only object-inspect's optional ./util.inspect browser request to an empty virtual module during Vite resolution, so .custom is undefined as the package's browser mapping intends; no runtime compatibility module is shipped.
tradeoff: Vite's generic browser-external proxy intentionally throws for property access, while this dependency expects absence to be a normal empty module. A narrowly scoped build resolver preserves that browser contract without polyfilling Node util or changing the Cartesia protocol. Cartesia's other Node dependencies still require a real browser import check.

fresh_build_evidence.finding: The rebuilt Cartesia chunk has no __vite-browser-external import. Its object-inspect initialization now reads F.custom from F=(ct(),e(st)), where st=n({custom:()=>void 0}) and ct is an empty initializer. Thus the optional hook is undefined without throwing. The SDK is loaded by a dynamic import from use-agent-execution-TbE0VXos.js only when the speech connection is requested. The prior baseline chunk use-agent-execution-ChUM3C1A.js directly imported __vite-browser-external and read F.custom during module initialization.
